name: SNN-MSSC: SNN-weighted multi-scale spectral
tagline: Spectral clustering whose affinity is a self-tuning multi-scale RBF gated by SNN weights, with adaptive PCA for high-dim data.
init_recovers: Ng-Jordan-Weiss spectral clustering when SNN_w=1 and one bandwidth scale
diff_from_baseline: None of the kmeans/dbscan/hdbscan baselines are spectral. This proposal builds a custom affinity W = SNN_weight x mean_s self-tuning Gaussian, applies the standard normalized Laplacian + eigsh + KMeans pipeline, and adds a PCA preprocessing step for d>15. The agent introduces SNN gating and multi-scale Gaussian averaging as the algorithmic novelty.

name: SOHC: silhouette-arbitrated HDBSCAN/KMeans
tagline: Run both HDBSCAN and KMeans on PCA(95%) features and pick the labeling with the higher silhouette score (with sensible fallbacks).
init_recovers: Equivalent to HDBSCAN baseline when its silhouette dominates, KMeans baseline otherwise
diff_from_baseline: Combines the kmeans and hdbscan baselines into a single estimator: each method is fit independently (with PCA(0.95) preprocessing when d>50), silhouette is computed on the same processed X, and the higher-silhouette labeling wins; degenerate single-cluster outputs trigger a fallback to the other method.

name: Manifold-constrained density-adaptive spectral
tagline: Self-tuning Gaussian affinity multiplied by a symmetric K-NN connectivity mask, then SpectralClustering with cluster_qr assignment.

key_hyperparams.name: affinity
key_hyperparams.value: self-tuning Gaussian masked by kNN union

init_recovers: Self-tuning spectral clustering when A_sym is all-ones
diff_from_baseline: Different family from kmeans/dbscan/hdbscan. Implements Zelnik-Manor self-tuning spectral clustering with a Hadamard kNN connectivity mask to suppress cross-manifold short circuits in high-D, and uses sklearn's SpectralClustering with cluster_qr discretization.

name: Geometry-routed spectral / GMM / KMeans consensus
tagline: Pick k by silhouette, build a kNN graph to score manifoldness/density-CV, then ensemble spectral, GMM, KMeans and choose with agreement-weighted silhouette.
init_recovers: Plain KMeans baseline when graph route is rejected and KMeans wins arbitration
diff_from_baseline: Hybrid of all three baseline families. Computes density-CV and mutual-kNN-asymmetry to gate inclusion of SpectralClustering, always runs GMM(full) and KMeans on PCA-reduced features, then picks the labeling that maximizes silhouette + 0.15*Sum_other ARI + small mode-priors. predict() reuses cached centroids in the chosen embedding instead of re-fitting.

name: Self-tuning spectral with adaptive PCA + KMeans
tagline: PCA when d>20, kNN graph with sigma_i x sigma_j RBF, eigenvectors of the normalized affinity, KMeans on row-normalized embedding.
init_recovers: Standard Ng-Jordan-Weiss spectral clustering with self-tuning bandwidths
diff_from_baseline: Different family from the kmeans/dbscan/hdbscan baselines. Builds a symmetric self-tuning kNN affinity graph, does the normalized-Laplacian eigendecomposition by hand (numpy.eigh), row-normalizes the top-k embedding, and clusters it with a high-restart KMeans. PCA is applied automatically when d>20.
